description: Ledger entries written by approvals, newest first, optionally for one mandate or household, with the total. Each is an evidence record (hash over its inputs and outputs, Ed25519-signed with the key at /api/v1/records/keys) naming the stored decision it came from. Values are PROJECTED and NOMINAL against each decision's own baseline; the total is a sum of projections, not realized value. Any key role. Same as GET /api/v1/ledger.
name: get_ledger
